requirements.name: CI verifies downloaded executables before execution
CI watch timeout is a deterministic policy state
Living documentation distinguishes every delivery state
Native SDD filesystem operations are root-confined
Promotion ends in a verified installable release
Required network state is enforced without probing
SDD status reports only provable associations
Storage lifecycle is inspectable and dry-run first
Telemetry storage and read work are bounded
Terminal task storage is physically bounded
Test and hygiene gates are observational
The Go and CI baseline has one patched source of truth
